title: Neighbours From Hell Turn A Dispute Into Complete Chaos
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 14th, 2024, officers were called to a neighborhood regarding two neighbors who had a major dispute about parking space. When officers arrived, the scene was already chaotic. One of the neighbors had walked on their porch and instigated a fight. That's where things began. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
